headline: Flooded railway at Pekalongan cancels 124 train trips
summary: Banjir di jalur rel Km 88+400 hingga Km 89+100 di Pekalongan pada 16–19 Januari 2026 membuat 124 perjalanan kereta api dibatalkan. KAI meninggikan rel sepanjang 600 meter sekitar 50 cm; per 21 Januari 85 persen perjalanan kembali normal.
summary_id: Banjir di jalur rel Km 88+400 hingga Km 89+100 di Pekalongan pada 16–19 Januari 2026 membuat 124 perjalanan kereta api dibatalkan. KAI meninggikan rel sepanjang 600 meter sekitar 50 cm; per 21 Januari 85 persen perjalanan kembali normal.
summary_en: Flooding on the rail line at Km 88+400 to Km 89+100 in Pekalongan between 16 and 19 January 2026 caused 124 train trips to be cancelled. KAI is raising 600 m of track by about 50 cm; by 21 January 85 percent of services were back to normal.
